notes: Design fidelity holds: surfaces are near-black (#121212/#181818/#1f1f1f), there is one #1ed760 accent, buttons are uppercase 9999px pills, badges are compact, and type stays between 10 and 24px. Typecheck and lint pass. Commit 7432f3b fixes most of the 19 earlier findings. Fixed: the recorded run is no longer overwritten by the live tour (live.tour === bundled.tour keeps the bundle, and guests read 'live on devnet', not 'booked by you'); the show page now looks the show up in its own band's tour, so 8-own-show.png reads 'Berlin, Huxleys Neue Welt, Day 1'; feed lines name the city (cityOf); the stepper has one column per step; the 'proposed' attention dot uses --info; the feed page gets a 'devnet is busy' retry state; the post-booking screen counts every show and links a tx receipt; a partial booking survives a reload; the band's own show page says what the show means for the band instead of offering a buy box; there is a phone shot of the booked dashboard and a show-page shot. Partly fixed: resume now reuses the first attempt's clock, but that adds new failure modes (below); fetchShowEvents throws only when no show's signatures can be read, so a rate-limited getParsedTransaction still yields 'nothing else has happened yet', and 7-booked-dashboard.png shows that line beside 320 fans; the demo-clock note appears only on the band's live dashboard (not on the show page or the recorded run); phone venues is down from 15,027 to 10,448 px. The fans/euros change adds new contradictions. Only part of each surface is converted, so the same card reads '240 of 400 fans' and then 'Confirmed with 12 sold; still selling'. At-risk cards lose their 'Behind pace … % of window left' reason. The show page shows 'Ticket €20' but its button says 'Buy 1 for 0.0002 SOL' and its table lists 'Paid' in SOL. The feed speaks in tickets and SOL. Any chain-read tour gets the euro scale, including tours booked by the agents, which are priced in SOL. Still open: no reason is given when a wallet that already holds a ticket cannot buy again; an invalid ?address= reads as a network error; the slot order in fetchShowEvents is unused; the doc comments in format.ts are stacked; the font is not shipped; the wizard shows a bare 'Waiting for devnet…'. Three of the phone shots (/feed, /band, /tour/new) are byte-identical copies of the guest landing page, so phone width is unverified for connected pages.
issues: packages/web/src/components/ShowCard.tsx:59 with lib/health.ts:54-68 and app/page.tsx:181,189,193: bandUnits converts only the sold/capacity row. The status line stays in sample tickets: 7-booked-dashboard.png shows '240 of 400 fans' above 'Confirmed with 12 sold; still selling'. The cancelled status ('Missed 10 by the deadline') and the attention lines ('(5/10 sold)', 'behind pace: 6 more needed') do the same. For onSale, the override also drops the at-risk reason ('Behind pace … % of the selling window left') and turns 'Threshold reached; confirms at the next check' into '0 more fans and it goes ahead'. Fix: give showView a units formatter (or a bandUnits flag) so that status and the attention text are built in fans, and keep the behind-pace and threshold-reached wording

packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:221,233,282: in live mode the stats read 'Ticket €20' and 'Fans 80 / 400', but a fan sees 'Buy 1 for 0.0002 SOL', 'You hold 1 ticket (0.0002 SOL)' and a SOL 'Paid' column. Under the page's own scale, one on-chain ticket is 20 fans and €400. Fix: in live mode, label the button 'Buy 1 ticket · stands for 20 fans · €400 play money (0.0002 SOL)' and show the table's Qty and Paid in fans and euros, with SOL as a muted secondary

packages/web/src/lib/chain-live.ts:118-122: feed lines for a fans/euros tour still say 'A fan bought 1 ticket (4 sold so far)', 'Threshold met (10/20)', 'A fan got 0.0002 SOL back' and 'Paid out 0.004 SOL'. These contradict the cards and the stats directly above them. Fix: pass a units option to fetchShowEvents/describe (fans = ticketsSold*FANS_PER_TICKET, euros()) when the tour is a live one

packages/web/src/app/page.tsx:152,207 with lib/format.ts:18-20: bandUnits/euros apply to every chain-read tour (run.cluster==='live'), including tours booked by the agents' --band-keypair path and ?band= views. Those are priced at about 0.005 SOL per ticket (orchestrator.ts:133), so the page shows about €500 tickets and five-figure escrow. Fix: use the fan/euro scale only when the tickets are priced on the wizard's scale (ticketPriceLamports <= 200*LAMPORTS_PER_EURO) or carry a units flag on the tour, and fall back to tickets and SOL otherwise

packages/web/src/lib/book.ts:169-177: resume derives base from the first attempt's deadlines. Resumed after about 30 min, the new shows have under 10 minutes of sales (or a passed deadline), and the keeper's venue rule (keeper.ts minSalesSec 600) rejects them. After 8 h, date exceeds tour.ends_at and propose_show fails with InvalidDates, so the booking is stuck. If the re-plan picks different venues, no stop matches, base falls back to now (the old Day-150 bug), and the tour gains more shows than planned. Fix: refuse to resume when base - now < SALES_MINUTES*60/2 or the plan's venues do not cover the existing shows; offer 'Start a new tour' instead

packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:36-47,90,239: the partial-booking marker in localStorage is never checked against chain and cannot be dismissed. 'Change answers' is hidden, but the answer chips still work, so a different start city, length or price is booked into the old tour, and every later booking resumes into it. Fix: on load, check that tour toursCreated-1 matches saved.tourId and still lacks shows (else clear it); add a 'Discard and start over' link; lock the answers while resuming

packages/web/src/app/page.tsx:405 and app/feed/page.tsx:76: the empty text 'Your shows are booked; nothing else has happened yet' is still unconditional. fetchShowEvents (chain-live.ts:220-231) returns [] when getParsedTransaction is rate-limited, and 7-booked-dashboard.png shows that sentence beside 320 fans and a confirmed Hamburg. Fix: when any show has ticketsSold > 0 or is past proposed, say 'Reading activity from devnet…' instead, or have fetchShowEvents report 'signatures found but not decoded yet'

packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:196-211,249-258: on the band's own page, the msg line (network errors) and the check-the-result-now crank sit only inside the fan's ticket card. A band never sees 'Could not reach the network' and cannot settle its own show when the keeper is down. Fix: move the msg block and the crank button below both cards

packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:32,72-96: live, run, others and venueName are never reset when address changes (replacement links navigate client-side), so the previous show's city and units can persist, and live stays true for a recorded show. Fix: reset these at the top of the effect keyed on address

packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:78-83 with lib/chain-live.ts:69: only the band's latest tour is searched, so a show from an earlier tour (after the band books a new one, which the wizard invites) shows an h1 of 'Show' and SOL units again. Fix: derive the tour from acct.tour and fetch that tour's shows (fetchTour(acct.tour)) instead of the latest one

packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:173-180: 'Deadline 29m 50s' / 'Show date 59m 50s' sit beside 'Day 1 · Nov 3' without the demo-clock note the dashboard now has. Fix: label them 'Sales close in' / 'Show in' and add the one-line demo scale note (or a title tooltip)

packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:218-222: a wallet that holds a ticket gets no buy control and no reason (one Ticket PDA per wallet per show). Fix: add 'One purchase per wallet per show' under the holding line

packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:262-288: 'Tickets (0)' renders as a bare header row, even beside 'Fans 80 / 400' in 8-own-show.png (fetchTicketsForShow uses getProgramAccounts, which public devnet often refuses). Fix: add an empty row ('No tickets read yet') and catch the ticket fetch separately so it does not fail the whole reload

packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:253-254: 'one ticket per 20 people, at €20 = 0.0002 SOL' tells the band that an on-chain ticket costs €20, while the dashboard counts the same ticket as 20 fans and €400. Fix: say 'each on-chain ticket stands for 20 fans and costs 0.0002 SOL of play money (€20 per fan)'

packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:41-55: an invalid ?address= still reads as 'Could not reach the network (Invalid public key input)'. Fix: validate it with try/new PublicKey before fetching and say 'Not a show address'

packages/web/src/lib/chain-live.ts:202,216,235: the per-signature 'slot order' is still computed and never used. Events from different transactions in the same second sort by decode id, which follows newest-first signature order, so they come out reversed. Fix: sort by (blockTime, slot), with the slot from getSignaturesForAddress

packages/web/src/app/venues/page.tsx:196: phone-venues.png is still 10,448 px tall. Two rooms per city on a phone helps, but all 40+ city cards stay open. Fix: default the phone list to the nearest country or collapse the city cards
packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:66: a profile read error still shows a bare 'Waiting for devnet…' with no detail and no retry
packages/web/src/lib/format.ts:40-41: two stacked doc comments on dayLabel; the first belongs to demoDate
packages/web/src/app/globals.css:22: SpotifyMixUI/CircularSp are not shipped, so every page renders in Helvetica/Arial. Fix: load a close open font (e.g. Figtree via next/font) as the first fallback

qa/src/ui-bot.ts:428-434: ux-phone-width opens /band, /feed and /tour/new without connecting, so phone-band.png, phone-feed.png and phone-tour-new.png are byte-identical guest landing pages and phone width is never checked on those connected pages. The booked check also passes with the 'nothing else has happened' feed beside 320 fans (no feed fixture) and has no shot of the fan's buy flow. Fix: connect() in the phone loop, add one fake signature with TicketBought/ShowConfirmed logs, and shoot /show as a fan
